title: Nvidia’s DLSS 5 Reframes AI Graphics as a Developer-Controlled Rendering Tool
dek: Ahead of its September 3 launch, Nvidia is emphasizing artistic control and frame fidelity after an early DLSS 5 demo drew backlash over AI-altered character imagery.
socialCaption: Nvidia is reintroducing DLSS 5 ahead of its September 3 launch with a new emphasis on developer control, artistic intent, and fidelity to the rendered frame. The key test: whether neural rendering can avoid the visible artifacts that sparked the initial backlash.
